label_rationale: flashLoan and deposit share a nonReentrant lock
mechanism: fee vault: the loan fee is booked as the cash gained across the callback
arm_reason: a state-changing callback with a user/frozen target; the general assume-guarantee arm applies

closure.justification: functions whose read/write effects intersect the proof footprint ['_status', 'cash', 'deposits', 'feesEarned']

ghost_state.name: snapCash
ghost_state.meaning: cash at loan entry (the repayment baseline)

composition.rule: admissible callbacks preserve I_exp; the post-phase restores I_stable, which implies phi

mcvp_rounds.ag_spec_rendered:
Assume-Guarantee specification for FeeVault_FL04a
  target property phi : cash >= deposits + feesEarned
  exposure site       : flashLoan.onFlashLoan  (flash-loan callback)
  ghost state         : uint256 snapCash

  [A_cb]  ASSUMPTION
          During flashLoan's exposed phase, re-entrant control is confined to the
          callback closure ['deposit', 'repay', 'flashLoan']; every such callback is admitted by the
          protocol, with bounded depth-one nesting.
          discharged by: conservative-closure soundness gate (static, not the LLM)

  [G_pre] GUARANTEE
          {cash >= deposits + feesEarned && _status == 1} pre-phase {snapCash >= deposits + feesEarned && _status == 2}
          discharged by: OBL_pre

  [G_exp] GUARANTEE
          forall f in A_cb. {I_exp} f {I_exp}   (I_exp = snapCash >= deposits + feesEarned && _status == 2)
          discharged by: ['OBL_cb_deposit', 'OBL_cb_repay', 'OBL_cb_flashLoan']

  [G_post] GUARANTEE
          {I_exp} post-phase {cash >= deposits + feesEarned && _status == 1 /\ snapCash==0}
          discharged by: OBL_post

  COMPOSITION THEOREM (instance):
    A_cb => (G_pre /\ G_exp /\ G_post) => cash >= deposits + feesEarned
      where callbacks are confined to admissible_callbacks=['deposit', 'repay', 'flashLoan'], depth-one

obligations.purpose: callback deposit preserves I_exp (depth-one) or is excluded by its guard during exposure
obligations.excluded: guard unsatisfiable during exposure (callback excluded from the admissible set)

obligations.purpose: callback flashLoan preserves I_exp (depth-one) or is excluded by its guard during exposure
obligations.excluded: guard unsatisfiable during exposure (callback excluded from the admissible set)
